entries.value: keeps a list of overheard compliments
always sits with her back to a wall
hums the same four notes when nervous
names every appliance in the house
cannot leave a library without a new bookmark
eats one thing at a time, in order
quotes weather reports as if they were poetry
keeps receipts in a cigar box
refuses to walk on the left side of anyone
taps a rhythm on doorframes before entering
saves the last bite for whoever is quietest
